title: BANFF: Moraine Lake & Lake Louise | 6 HOURS SIGHTSEEING
includes: Ample free time at both Lake Louise and Moraine Lake
Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the beauty of Canada’s world-famous Rocky Mountains on this budget-friendly 6-hours tour from Banff to Lake Louise and Moraine Lake.

Perfect for first-time visitors, newcomers to Canada, families, and travellers with limited time, shared shuttle-style tour makes it easy to see two of Banff National Park’s most iconic lakes in one unforgettable trip. Sit back, relax, and enjoy breathtaking mountain views, turquoise glacier waters, and picture-perfect scenery without the stress of parking, driving, or dealing with entry restrictions.

✅ This is a budget-friendly shared transportation experience, ideal for guests who want a simple and convenient way to visit both lakes.

✅ No Parking Stress: Avoid the hassle of driving, parking, and restrictions.

✅ Photo Opportunities: Enjoy time to explore, take beautiful photos, and experience the peaceful scenery of both lakes.

✅ Best For: First-time visitors, newcomers to Canada, families, and travellers with limited time in Banff.
